findings.evidence: <input id="email" class="entry" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" size="15"> (size=15)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 20 characters.
findings.violation: This email field shows 15 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Move the rule into hint text beside the field, linked with aria-describedby.
findings.violation: A format rule appears only in the placeholder, which disappears as soon as typing starts.

findings.fix: Add autocorrect=off and spellcheck=false, and autocapitalize=none.
findings.violation: On this username field, autocorrection and spellchecking stay on and auto-capitalization stays on, so a phone keyboard can change a value it does not know.

findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.

instances.evidence: <input id="card" class="entry" name="membership_number" placeholder="Must be 10 digits" required>
<input id="email" class="entry" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" size="15">

findings.violation: The text in this field is 14 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.

findings.evidence: <input id="card" class="entry" name="membership_number" placeholder="Must be 10 digits" required>
findings.violation: This account number is a text field without the numeric input mode, so a phone shows the full keyboard for digits.

findings.fix: Explain the asterisk in text before the first field, or mark optional fields in words instead.
findings.violation: Labels carry an asterisk, but nothing in the form says what the asterisk means.

note: golden-03.html is a library sign-in form exercising the CSS-reading criteria and an instance list. One stylesheet rule sizes three inputs at 14 pixels, so FORMS-INPUT-FONT-SIZE reports one finding with the other two fields as instances, at severity 2 because 14 is not below 12. The email field declares size 15, under the 20 an email needs, so FORMS-FIELD-WIDTH is the narrow branch at 3. The library card number is a text field without the numeric input mode (FORMS-NUMERIC-INPUTMODE, 2), and its rule Must be 10 digits lives only in the placeholder (FORMS-PLACEHOLDER-INSTRUCTION, the rule branch at 3). Labels carry an asterisk nothing explains (FORMS-REQUIRED-OPTIONAL, 2). The username leaves autocorrect and auto-capitalization on (FORMS-AUTOCORRECT, one field, 2). Four one-character boxes split the code (FORMS-SPLIT-ENTITY, one split value, 2).
